content: अपसव्य, -सव्यक {%a.%} .²1 Not on the left, right; मण्डलान्यपसव्यानि खगाश्चकू रथं प्रति <ls>Rām. 6. 57. 34</ls> अपसव्येन हस्तेन <ls>Ms. 3. 214</ls>. .²2 Contrary, opposite यद्येतदपसव्यं ते वचो मम भविष्यति <ls>Mb. 5. 138. 27</ls>. .{@-व्यम्@} {%ind.%} To the right, making the sacred thread hang down towards the left part of the body over the right shoulder (<ab>opp.</ab> सव्यम् when it hangs over the left); a position of the thread in Śrāddha or other religious ceremonies at particular times of those ceremonies (the three positions being सव्य, निवीत & अपसव्य); प्राचीनावीतिना सम्यगपसव्यमतन्द्रिणा . पित्र्यमानिधनात्कार्यं विधिवद्दर्भपाणिना .. <ls>Ms. 3. 279</ls>; ˚व्यं कृ to go round one so as to keep the right side towards him; to make the sacred thread hang over the right shoulder.
